title: A back-test summary for a roof program
heading: Read Every Difference as a Question, Not a Verdict
cases: each roof of a cycle is counted once as kept, added or dropped, and agreement is the share of approved roofs kept
a project both plans fund in different years is moved, not kept
a cycle today's model was not run on is marked missing, not read as a plan that dropped everything
a cycle that approved nothing agrees fully with a rerun that funds nothing
